export.description: Build a skill export for a chat assistant that cannot load skills itself.

build.help: Select skills, bundle them for retrieval, and write the export.
build.preset: Named selection to start from: 'knowledge' or 'everything'.
build.config: Path to an export config file. Need not be checked in.
build.domains: Comma-separated domains to restrict the export to.
build.instructions: Instruction template. Use {{BUNDLE_MAP}} where routing should go.
build.dry_run: Print the plan without writing anything.
build.strict: Fail instead of merging bundles when a limit would be exceeded.
build.summary: Selected {{skills}} skills, {{words}} words, into {{files}} of {{max_files}} allowed files:
build.instruction_size: Instructions are {{chars}} characters. The Gem instruction field's limit is undocumented — if it rejects them, shorten the template rather than the routing block.
